reason: Turbo includes Solana buffer-layout utilities, but lib/arweave/client.ts constructs ArweaveSigner (RSA) and uploads JSON. It never selects a Solana signer or calls toBigIntLE. No patched upstream release is available; reassess before enabling Solana functionality.
